result.description: A fictional handheld voice recorder and file capsule built for quick note capture on modern laptops and phones. The EchoPen uses USB-C connectivity, 16GB of internal flash storage, and a compact pen-style body with a built-in microphone, LED status ring, and one-button recording. It is designed for interviews, lectures, and field notes rather than mass data storage, gaming, or graphics workloads.
result.title: Lunaris EchoPen 16GB USB-C Voice Capsule
